title.narrative: SWE-2011-202 Frictions, fractures and cultural resilience of Swahili coastal towns
SWE-2011-202 Frictions, fractures and cultural resilience of Swahili coastal towns

description.narrative: The project aims to study the recent history of nominations and inscription to the UNESCO World heritage that the Stone Town of Zanzibar and Bagamoyo, in Tanzania, has/are undergoing and its consequences. A lot of effort and resources, both locally and internationally, has been invested in these projects. We want to study the social results of this. How has it influenced the identity, the civil society, and the understanding of these places. Are the inhabitants loyal to the inscription/nomination, and do they see it as benefitting for them? Which narratives have survived the processes and are today used to describe them. How do they reflect the experts narratives. Do the inhabitants recognize any benefits from the World Heritage. Or the opposite.
